events.name: Fort White Town Council — Regular Meeting (Dissolution Ordinance First Reading on Agenda)
events.description: Regular Fort White Town Council meeting. A first reading of an ordinance to dissolve the town is on the agenda, though its future is uncertain after council members and residents found no support for dissolution at the February 17 special meeting. Meeting confirmed at 6 PM at the Fort White Community Center.
